Module org.apache.jena.core
Package org.apache.jena.mem.store.indexed

Class IndexedSetTripleStore

java.lang.Object
org.apache.jena.mem.store.indexed.IndexedSetTripleStore
All Implemented Interfaces:
org.apache.jena.atlas.lib.Copyable<TripleStore>, TripleStore
public class IndexedSetTripleStore extends Object implements TripleStore
TripleStore that stores all triples in a single TripleSet and delegates pattern-matching to a configurable StoreStrategy. The strategy is selected via an IndexingStrategy and may swap itself out at runtime (e.g. a LazyStoreStrategy replaces itself with an EagerStoreStrategy as soon as the first pattern lookup is performed).

The triples themselves are kept in triples; each triple has a stable index in that set, which the strategy uses to maintain subject/predicate/object indices of integer indices rather than triple references.

      public IndexedSetTripleStore copy()
      Description copied from interface: TripleStore
